name: SO/Paris
insider_take: This ultra-modern tower rises above the Seine like a crystalline beacon, offering breathtaking panoramas of Paris from every angle.
whats_special: SO/Paris occupies floors 6-27 of a striking glass tower designed by Jean Nouvel, featuring rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows and unobstructed views of iconic landmarks like the Eiffel Tower, Notre-Dame, and Sacré-Cœur. The hotel's avant-garde design includes fashion-forward interiors by Karl Lagerfeld and a rooftop bar that's become a coveted destination for Parisians.
pro_tip: Book a river-facing room on higher floors for the most spectacular sunset views over the Seine, and visit the rooftop Kuklos bar during golden hour when the entire city glows beneath you.
dont_miss: The hotel sits directly on the Seine in the trendy 13th arrondissement, steps from the François Mitterrand Library and a short metro ride to central Paris. The surrounding area features contemporary art galleries, riverside walking paths, and the emerging Left Bank dining scene that locals are raving about.
pros: Prime location in the heart of Paris with easy access to major attractions
Contemporary design with stylish, modern interiors
Exceptional rooftop terrace with panoramic city views
Innovative culinary experiences and unique dining concepts
cons: Modern aesthetic may not appeal to traditional luxury seekers
